326inline void setMarginValue(QMargins &margins, QCP::MarginSide side, int value)
327{
328 switch (side)
329 {
330 case QCP::msLeft: margins.setLeft(value); break;
331 case QCP::msRight: margins.setRight(value); break;
332 case QCP::msTop: margins.setTop(value); break;
333 case QCP::msBottom: margins.setBottom(value); break;
334 case QCP::msAll: margins = QMargins(value, value, value, value); break;
335 default: break;
336 }
337}
338
346inline int getMarginValue(const QMargins &margins, QCP::MarginSide side)
347{
348 switch (side)
349 {
350 case QCP::msLeft: return margins.left();
351 case QCP::msRight: return margins.right();
352 case QCP::msTop: return margins.top();
353 case QCP::msBottom: return margins.bottom();
354 default: break;
355 }
356 return 0;
357}

2664template <class DataType>
2665void QCPDataContainer<DataType>::add(const QCPDataContainer<DataType> &data)
2666{
2667 if (data.isEmpty())
2668 return;
2669
2670 const int n = data.size();
2671 const int oldSize = size();
2672
2673 if (oldSize > 0 && !qcpLessThanSortKey<DataType>(*constBegin(), *(data.constEnd()-1))) // prepend if new data keys are all smaller than or equal to existing ones
2674 {
2675 if (mPreallocSize < n)
2676 preallocateGrow(n);
2677 mPreallocSize -= n;
2678 std::copy(data.constBegin(), data.constEnd(), begin());
2679 } else // don't need to prepend, so append and merge if necessary
2680 {
2681 mData.resize(mData.size()+n);
2682 std::copy(data.constBegin(), data.constEnd(), end()-n);
2683 if (oldSize > 0 && !qcpLessThanSortKey<DataType>(*(constEnd()-n-1), *(constEnd()-n))) // if appended range keys aren't all greater than existing ones, merge the two partitions
2684 std::inplace_merge(begin(), end()-n, end(), qcpLessThanSortKey<DataType>);
2685 }
2686}

2696template <class DataType>
2697void QCPDataContainer<DataType>::add(const QVector<DataType> &data, bool alreadySorted)
2698{
2699 if (data.isEmpty())
2700 return;
2701 if (isEmpty())
2702 {
2703 set(data, alreadySorted);
2704 return;
2705 }
2706
2707 const int n = data.size();
2708 const int oldSize = size();
2709
2710 if (alreadySorted && oldSize > 0 && !qcpLessThanSortKey<DataType>(*constBegin(), *(data.constEnd()-1))) // prepend if new data is sorted and keys are all smaller than or equal to existing ones
2711 {
2712 if (mPreallocSize < n)
2713 preallocateGrow(n);
2714 mPreallocSize -= n;
2715 std::copy(data.constBegin(), data.constEnd(), begin());
2716 } else // don't need to prepend, so append and then sort and merge if necessary
2717 {
2718 mData.resize(mData.size()+n);
2719 std::copy(data.constBegin(), data.constEnd(), end()-n);
2720 if (!alreadySorted) // sort appended subrange if it wasn't already sorted
2721 std::sort(end()-n, end(), qcpLessThanSortKey<DataType>);
2722 if (oldSize > 0 && !qcpLessThanSortKey<DataType>(*(constEnd()-n-1), *(constEnd()-n))) // if appended range keys aren't all greater than existing ones, merge the two partitions
2723 std::inplace_merge(begin(), end()-n, end(), qcpLessThanSortKey<DataType>);
2724 }
2725}

2737 {

2748 mData.insert(insertionPoint, data);

2952template <class DataType>
2953QCPRange QCPDataContainer<DataType>::keyRange(bool &foundRange, QCP::SignDomain signDomain)
2954{
2955 if (isEmpty())
2956 {
2957 foundRange = false;
2958 return QCPRange();
2959 }
2960 QCPRange range;
2961 bool haveLower = false;
2962 bool haveUpper = false;
2963 double current;
2964
2965 QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator it = constBegin();
2966 QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator itEnd = constEnd();
2967 if (signDomain == QCP::sdBoth) // range may be anywhere
2968 {
2969 if (DataType::sortKeyIsMainKey()) // if DataType is sorted by main key (e.g. QCPGraph, but not QCPCurve), use faster algorithm by finding just first and last key with non-NaN value
2970 {
2971 while (it != itEnd) // find first non-nan going up from left
2972 {
2973 if (!qIsNaN(it->mainValue()))
2974 {
2975 range.lower = it->mainKey();
2976 haveLower = true;
2977 break;
2978 }
2979 ++it;
2980 }
2981 it = itEnd;
2982 while (it != constBegin()) // find first non-nan going down from right
2983 {
2984 --it;
2985 if (!qIsNaN(it->mainValue()))
2986 {
2987 range.upper = it->mainKey();
2988 haveUpper = true;
2989 break;
2990 }
2991 }
2992 } else // DataType is not sorted by main key, go through all data points and accordingly expand range
2993 {
2994 while (it != itEnd)
2995 {
2996 if (!qIsNaN(it->mainValue()))
2997 {
2998 current = it->mainKey();
2999 if (current < range.lower || !haveLower)
3000 {
3001 range.lower = current;
3002 haveLower = true;
3003 }
3004 if (current > range.upper || !haveUpper)
3005 {
3006 range.upper = current;
3007 haveUpper = true;
3008 }
3009 }
3010 ++it;
3011 }
3012 }
3013 } else if (signDomain == QCP::sdNegative) // range may only be in the negative sign domain
3014 {
3015 while (it != itEnd)
3016 {
3017 if (!qIsNaN(it->mainValue()))
3018 {
3019 current = it->mainKey();
3020 if ((current < range.lower || !haveLower) && current < 0)
3021 {
3022 range.lower = current;
3023 haveLower = true;
3024 }
3025 if ((current > range.upper || !haveUpper) && current < 0)
3026 {
3027 range.upper = current;
3028 haveUpper = true;
3029 }
3030 }
3031 ++it;
3032 }
3033 } else if (signDomain == QCP::sdPositive) // range may only be in the positive sign domain
3034 {
3035 while (it != itEnd)
3036 {
3037 if (!qIsNaN(it->mainValue()))
3038 {
3039 current = it->mainKey();
3040 if ((current < range.lower || !haveLower) && current > 0)
3041 {
3042 range.lower = current;
3043 haveLower = true;
3044 }
3045 if ((current > range.upper || !haveUpper) && current > 0)
3046 {
3047 range.upper = current;
3048 haveUpper = true;
3049 }
3050 }
3051 ++it;
3052 }
3053 }
3054
3055 foundRange = haveLower && haveUpper;
3056 return range;
3057}
3058
3075template <class DataType>
3076QCPRange QCPDataContainer<DataType>::valueRange(bool &foundRange, QCP::SignDomain signDomain, const QCPRange &inKeyRange)
3077{
3078 if (isEmpty())
3079 {
3080 foundRange = false;
3081 return QCPRange();
3082 }
3083 QCPRange range;
3084 const bool restrictKeyRange = inKeyRange != QCPRange();
3085 bool haveLower = false;
3086 bool haveUpper = false;
3087 QCPRange current;
3088 QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator itBegin = constBegin();
3089 QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator itEnd = constEnd();
3090 if (DataType::sortKeyIsMainKey() && restrictKeyRange)
3091 {
3092 itBegin = findBegin(inKeyRange.lower);
3093 itEnd = findEnd(inKeyRange.upper);
3094 }
3095 if (signDomain == QCP::sdBoth) // range may be anywhere
3096 {
3097 for (QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator it = itBegin; it != itEnd; ++it)
3098 {
3099 if (restrictKeyRange && (it->mainKey() < inKeyRange.lower || it->mainKey() > inKeyRange.upper))
3100 continue;
3101 current = it->valueRange();
3102 if ((current.lower < range.lower || !haveLower) && !qIsNaN(current.lower))
3103 {
3104 range.lower = current.lower;
3105 haveLower = true;
3106 }
3107 if ((current.upper > range.upper || !haveUpper) && !qIsNaN(current.upper))
3108 {
3109 range.upper = current.upper;
3110 haveUpper = true;
3111 }
3112 }
3113 } else if (signDomain == QCP::sdNegative) // range may only be in the negative sign domain
3114 {
3115 for (QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator it = itBegin; it != itEnd; ++it)
3116 {
3117 if (restrictKeyRange && (it->mainKey() < inKeyRange.lower || it->mainKey() > inKeyRange.upper))
3118 continue;
3119 current = it->valueRange();
3120 if ((current.lower < range.lower || !haveLower) && current.lower < 0 && !qIsNaN(current.lower))
3121 {
3122 range.lower = current.lower;
3123 haveLower = true;
3124 }
3125 if ((current.upper > range.upper || !haveUpper) && current.upper < 0 && !qIsNaN(current.upper))
3126 {
3127 range.upper = current.upper;
3128 haveUpper = true;
3129 }
3130 }
3131 } else if (signDomain == QCP::sdPositive) // range may only be in the positive sign domain
3132 {
3133 for (QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator it = itBegin; it != itEnd; ++it)
3134 {
3135 if (restrictKeyRange && (it->mainKey() < inKeyRange.lower || it->mainKey() > inKeyRange.upper))
3136 continue;
3137 current = it->valueRange();
3138 if ((current.lower < range.lower || !haveLower) && current.lower > 0 && !qIsNaN(current.lower))
3139 {
3140 range.lower = current.lower;
3141 haveLower = true;
3142 }
3143 if ((current.upper > range.upper || !haveUpper) && current.upper > 0 && !qIsNaN(current.upper))
3144 {
3145 range.upper = current.upper;
3146 haveUpper = true;
3147 }
3148 }
3149 }
3150
3151 foundRange = haveLower && haveUpper;
3152 return range;
3153}

3163template <class DataType>
3164void QCPDataContainer<DataType>::limitIteratorsToDataRange(const_iterator &begin, const_iterator &end, const QCPDataRange &dataRange) const
3165{
3166 QCPDataRange iteratorRange(begin-constBegin(), end-constBegin());
3167 iteratorRange = iteratorRange.bounded(dataRange.bounded(this->dataRange()));
3168 begin = constBegin()+iteratorRange.begin();
3169 end = constBegin()+iteratorRange.end();
3170}

3181template <class DataType>
3182void QCPDataContainer<DataType>::preallocateGrow(int minimumPreallocSize)
3183{
3184 if (minimumPreallocSize <= mPreallocSize)
3185 return;
3186
3187 int newPreallocSize = minimumPreallocSize;
3188 newPreallocSize += (1u<<qBound(4, mPreallocIteration+4, 15)) - 12; // do 4 up to 32768-12 preallocation, doubling in each intermediate iteration
3189 ++mPreallocIteration;
3190
3191 int sizeDifference = newPreallocSize-mPreallocSize;
3192 mData.resize(mData.size()+sizeDifference);
3193 std::copy_backward(mData.begin()+mPreallocSize, mData.end()-sizeDifference, mData.end());
3194 mPreallocSize = newPreallocSize;
3195}
3196
3211template <class DataType>
3212void QCPDataContainer<DataType>::performAutoSqueeze()
3213{
3214 const int totalAlloc = mData.capacity();
3215 const int postAllocSize = totalAlloc-mData.size();
3216 const int usedSize = size();
3217 bool shrinkPostAllocation = false;
3218 bool shrinkPreAllocation = false;
3219 if (totalAlloc > 650000) // if allocation is larger, shrink earlier with respect to total used size
3220 {
3221 shrinkPostAllocation = postAllocSize > usedSize*1.5; // QVector grow strategy is 2^n for static data. Watch out not to oscillate!
3222 shrinkPreAllocation = mPreallocSize*10 > usedSize;
3223 } else if (totalAlloc > 1000) // below 10 MiB raw data be generous with preallocated memory, below 1k points don't even bother
3224 {
3225 shrinkPostAllocation = postAllocSize > usedSize*5;
3226 shrinkPreAllocation = mPreallocSize > usedSize*1.5; // preallocation can grow into postallocation, so can be smaller
3227 }
3228
3229 if (shrinkPreAllocation || shrinkPostAllocation)
3230 squeeze(shrinkPreAllocation, shrinkPostAllocation);
3231}

4214template <class DataType>
4215QCPDataSelection QCPAbstractPlottable1D<DataType>::selectTestRect(const QRectF &rect, bool onlySelectable) const
4216{
4217 QCPDataSelection result;
4218 if ((onlySelectable && mSelectable == QCP::stNone) || mDataContainer->isEmpty())
4219 return result;
4220 if (!mKeyAxis || !mValueAxis)
4221 return result;
4222
4223 // convert rect given in pixels to ranges given in plot coordinates:
4224 double key1, value1, key2, value2;
4225 pixelsToCoords(rect.topLeft(), key1, value1);
4226 pixelsToCoords(rect.bottomRight(), key2, value2);
4227 QCPRange keyRange(key1, key2); // QCPRange normalizes internally so we don't have to care about whether key1 < key2
4228 QCPRange valueRange(value1, value2);
4229 typename QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator begin = mDataContainer->constBegin();
4230 typename QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator end = mDataContainer->constEnd();
4231 if (DataType::sortKeyIsMainKey()) // we can assume that data is sorted by main key, so can reduce the searched key interval:
4232 {
4233 begin = mDataContainer->findBegin(keyRange.lower, false);
4234 end = mDataContainer->findEnd(keyRange.upper, false);
4235 }
4236 if (begin == end)
4237 return result;
4238
4239 int currentSegmentBegin = -1; // -1 means we're currently not in a segment that's contained in rect
4240 for (typename QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator it=begin; it!=end; ++it)
4241 {
4242 if (currentSegmentBegin == -1)
4243 {
4244 if (valueRange.contains(it->mainValue()) && keyRange.contains(it->mainKey())) // start segment
4245 currentSegmentBegin = it-mDataContainer->constBegin();
4246 } else if (!valueRange.contains(it->mainValue()) || !keyRange.contains(it->mainKey())) // segment just ended
4247 {
4248 result.addDataRange(QCPDataRange(currentSegmentBegin, it-mDataContainer->constBegin()), false);
4249 currentSegmentBegin = -1;
4250 }
4251 }
4252 // process potential last segment:
4253 if (currentSegmentBegin != -1)
4254 result.addDataRange(QCPDataRange(currentSegmentBegin, end-mDataContainer->constBegin()), false);
4255
4256 result.simplify();
4257 return result;
4258}

4285template <class DataType>
4286double QCPAbstractPlottable1D<DataType>::selectTest(const QPointF &pos, bool onlySelectable, QVariant *details) const
4287{
4288 if ((onlySelectable && mSelectable == QCP::stNone) || mDataContainer->isEmpty())
4289 return -1;
4290 if (!mKeyAxis || !mValueAxis)
4291 return -1;
4292
4293 QCPDataSelection selectionResult;
4294 double minDistSqr = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();
4295 int minDistIndex = mDataContainer->size();
4296
4297 typename QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator begin = mDataContainer->constBegin();
4298 typename QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator end = mDataContainer->constEnd();
4299 if (DataType::sortKeyIsMainKey()) // we can assume that data is sorted by main key, so can reduce the searched key interval:
4300 {
4301 // determine which key range comes into question, taking selection tolerance around pos into account:
4302 double posKeyMin, posKeyMax, dummy;
4303 pixelsToCoords(pos-QPointF(mParentPlot->selectionTolerance(), mParentPlot->selectionTolerance()), posKeyMin, dummy);
4304 pixelsToCoords(pos+QPointF(mParentPlot->selectionTolerance(), mParentPlot->selectionTolerance()), posKeyMax, dummy);
4305 if (posKeyMin > posKeyMax)
4306 qSwap(posKeyMin, posKeyMax);
4307 begin = mDataContainer->findBegin(posKeyMin, true);
4308 end = mDataContainer->findEnd(posKeyMax, true);
4309 }
4310 if (begin == end)
4311 return -1;
4312 QCPRange keyRange(mKeyAxis->range());
4313 QCPRange valueRange(mValueAxis->range());
4314 for (typename QCPDataContainer<DataType>::const_iterator it=begin; it!=end; ++it)
4315 {
4316 const double mainKey = it->mainKey();
4317 const double mainValue = it->mainValue();
4318 if (keyRange.contains(mainKey) && valueRange.contains(mainValue)) // make sure data point is inside visible range, for speedup in cases where sort key isn't main key and we iterate over all points
4319 {
4320 const double currentDistSqr = QCPVector2D(coordsToPixels(mainKey, mainValue)-pos).lengthSquared();
4321 if (currentDistSqr < minDistSqr)
4322 {
4323 minDistSqr = currentDistSqr;
4324 minDistIndex = it-mDataContainer->constBegin();
4325 }
4326 }
4327 }
4328 if (minDistIndex != mDataContainer->size())
4329 selectionResult.addDataRange(QCPDataRange(minDistIndex, minDistIndex+1), false);
4330
4331 selectionResult.simplify();
4332 if (details)
4333 details->setValue(selectionResult);
4334 return qSqrt(minDistSqr);
4335}

4347template <class DataType>
4348void QCPAbstractPlottable1D<DataType>::getDataSegments(QList<QCPDataRange> &selectedSegments, QList<QCPDataRange> &unselectedSegments) const
4349{
4350 selectedSegments.clear();
4351 unselectedSegments.clear();
4352 if (mSelectable == QCP::stWhole) // stWhole selection type draws the entire plottable with selected style if mSelection isn't empty
4353 {
4354 if (selected())
4355 selectedSegments << QCPDataRange(0, dataCount());
4356 else
4357 unselectedSegments << QCPDataRange(0, dataCount());
4358 } else
4359 {
4360 QCPDataSelection sel(selection());
4361 sel.simplify();
4362 selectedSegments = sel.dataRanges();
4363 unselectedSegments = sel.inverse(QCPDataRange(0, dataCount())).dataRanges();
4364 }
4365}

4377template <class DataType>
4378void QCPAbstractPlottable1D<DataType>::drawPolyline(QCPPainter *painter, const QVector<QPointF> &lineData) const
4379{
4380 // if drawing solid line and not in PDF, use much faster line drawing instead of polyline:
4381 if (mParentPlot->plottingHints().testFlag(QCP::phFastPolylines) &&
4382 painter->pen().style() == Qt::SolidLine &&
4383 !painter->modes().testFlag(QCPPainter::pmVectorized) &&
4384 !painter->modes().testFlag(QCPPainter::pmNoCaching))
4385 {
4386 int i = 0;
4387 bool lastIsNan = false;
4388 const int lineDataSize = lineData.size();
4389 while (i < lineDataSize && (qIsNaN(lineData.at(i).y()) || qIsNaN(lineData.at(i).x()))) // make sure first point is not NaN
4390 ++i;
4391 ++i; // because drawing works in 1 point retrospect
4392 while (i < lineDataSize)
4393 {
4394 if (!qIsNaN(lineData.at(i).y()) && !qIsNaN(lineData.at(i).x())) // NaNs create a gap in the line
4395 {
4396 if (!lastIsNan)
4397 painter->drawLine(lineData.at(i-1), lineData.at(i));
4398 else
4399 lastIsNan = false;
4400 } else
4401 lastIsNan = true;
4402 ++i;
4403 }
4404 } else
4405 {
4406 int segmentStart = 0;
4407 int i = 0;
4408 const int lineDataSize = lineData.size();
4409 while (i < lineDataSize)
4410 {
4411 if (qIsNaN(lineData.at(i).y()) || qIsNaN(lineData.at(i).x()) || qIsInf(lineData.at(i).y())) // NaNs create a gap in the line. Also filter Infs which make drawPolyline block
4412 {
4413 painter->drawPolyline(lineData.constData()+segmentStart, i-segmentStart); // i, because we don't want to include the current NaN point
4414 segmentStart = i+1;
4415 }
4416 ++i;
4417 }
4418 // draw last segment:
4419 painter->drawPolyline(lineData.constData()+segmentStart, lineDataSize-segmentStart);
4420 }
4421}
